prompt: Quick one — for my Likert items should I use a 5-point or 7-point scale? I keep reading conflicting things online, some people say more points is always better.

assertions.text: States there is no single universal optimum and that the choice depends on format and/or population
Explains that reliability/validity improve with more points then plateau (approx 5-7) and can degrade beyond ~7
Does NOT simply agree that more points is always better
Mentions the agree/disagree-specific finding to use 5 points, or distinguishes agree/disagree from item-specific formats
References full labeling and/or the confound between number of points and labeling
